essential_caveats: null means unavailable, never zero; only originally-null 2K26 fields were filled from approved historical sources, never estimated.
Jerseys are strings, 0 != 00; snapshot labels may be stale or numerically damaged.
Entire-season rosters of playoff-qualified teams, not actual playoff appearance lists.
Transaction-only and offseason associations do not establish games played; no inferred chronology.
NBA 2K26 combines preserved early baseline values and per-field historical supplements. Never label mixed records as one snapshot or as uniform final-season ratings.
Blacktop derived categories are excluded; unknown cat_* fields remain null unless a verified original HTML display was available.
